title: The Singing School
blurb: Reverend Kent has a meetinghouse and a winter, and nobody to lead the singing school or sing in it.
_note: Decision 0434 (Matt's picks, 9 Nov 2026): after Thadeous joins. Find the tune books, have the parts printed, and talk round singers: six townsfolk, each with a small condition; four is enough to go ahead. Walking into the Tankard while it's on only brings a warning. At dusk the meetinghouse fills with whoever came, and Thadeous learns The Whole Room, a rank up for each singer past four (story/singing.ts).

steps.title: The Singing School
steps.objective: Find something to sing from. Miss Sprague, the schoolmistress, will know.
